payload.title: Python newsroom unit tests: environment-dependent tests fail in CI (poetry/uv on PATH, Biblicus checkout, corpora dir)
payload.description: Found by PPY-302a5f. test_newsroom_tools (3) and test_papyrus_content (2) assume a local dev machine: poetry executable, uv executable, ../Biblicus checkout, corpora/ symlinks (corpus_key AI-ML-research, corpora/threat-intelligence). Make them hermetic with fakes. Excluded from tests.yml until fixed.
